certificates.title: Meta Front-End Developer
certificates.description: Professional certificate covering advanced React, accessibility, testing, and front-end development practices.
details: This program covered the full front-end spectrum: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and testing.
Projects included building accessible interfaces and writing component tests with industry tools.
The capstone project integrated everything into a complete, responsive application.

certificates.title: JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures
certificates.description: Certified understanding of core algorithms, data structures, and functional programming in JavaScript.
details: Covered arrays, objects, recursion, sorting, and searching algorithms in JavaScript.
Practiced problem-solving through interactive challenges and projects.
Strengthened the fundamentals that power efficient, clean code.

certificates.title: Google UX Design Professional
certificates.description: Professional certificate in UX design: research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.
details: Learned the complete UX process from user research to high-fidelity prototypes.
Built a portfolio of case studies using Figma and modern design systems.
Emphasized inclusive design and usability testing in every project.

certificates.title: AWS Cloud Practitioner

details: Gained a solid foundation in cloud computing concepts and core AWS services.
Learned about security, pricing models, and architectural best practices.
Useful for deploying and scaling web applications in the cloud.
